authoredNote: Lines computed from `nl -ba` of the committed fixture; the positive rows pin BOTH metadata.owner and metadata.ownerEvidence, and the negative row pins the ABSENT case (`meta.owner: null`) so an over-claim fails just as loudly as a miss.
rationale: PINS THE CAST CLASS: `const w = value as Widget` states the receiver type (evidence `cast`) even though `value` is `unknown`. The negative is the SAME initializer without the cast: it must carry NO owner. Casting is a claim the source makes; an un-cast unknown is not.
